bcho.2026.1.1.printed_source_pages: Theory Exam, English, printed pages 5–11 of 39
bcho.2026.1.1.source_format: Official examination paper (English), as distributed by the organisers
bcho.2026.1.1.source_variant_note: Original English theoretical examination paper of the 32nd Baltic Chemistry Olympiad (Riga, 12 May 2026), with answer boxes; points and % of total score as printed. No topic tags are printed. The cover page, general instructions, formulas and constants page, the 13C chemical-shift chart and periodic table page (page 4) and the answer boxes are not copied. The titration curves (page 10) and the 1H/13C/HSQC spectra (page 11) are printed as landscape pages after Task 5 and are placed at the end, with bracketed editorial labels. The pre-filled entries of the NMR assignment table (10,18; 6,23; 9,19; Impurity; 12,16) are printed in the paper and kept; the bracketed sentence on the blue/red numbering is editorial. The empty assignment boxes under the four titrated compounds in Task 5 are not reproduced. 'electrospray ionisation (EI)' is kept as printed. Printed task points sum to 80, as in the heading.
